text:
Alice: Quick sync — we need to prioritize the "capability discovery" API for launch planning. Customers keep asking about a single endpoint to tell them what a model supports (streaming, tools, JSON output, token limits).
Ben: Agreed. Big ask from two PB customers: streaming + tool-calls + high token budget.
Carla: Can we be explicit about scope? streaming + function calling + structured-output all in v1 sounds risky.
Dmitri: Tech constraints: streaming + large token budgets increases memory/KV pressure, and tool integrations require stable schemas. We should define tiers rather than an all-or-nothing flag.
Emma: Proposal: discovery endpoint returns capability flags + recommended "operating profile" (tier). Example response we can prototype:
```
{
  "model": "redwood-qa-1",
  "supports_streaming": true,
  "supports_function_calling": "partial", // "full"|"partial"|"none"
  "structured_output": "json_schema",
  "max_input_tokens": 131072,
  "max_total_tokens": 196608,
  "recommended_profile": "latency-optimized",
  "tools": ["search","calculator"],
  "notes": "function calling limited to 5 concurrent tool sessions"
}
```
Ben: Love the profile bit. Helps SDKs pick defaults. Also want explicit fallback pathways in the spec (if supports_streaming=false -> fallback to chunked polling).
Carla: Launch criteria idea: we ship v1 if all of the following are true: 1) discovery endpoint covers the 6 canonical flags (streaming, function_calling, structured_output, tools_list, max_tokens, profiles) 2) docs and SDKs surface the profile selection 3) one enterprise customer tested tool-calling end-to-end.
Dmitri: Implementation note: for "partial" function_calling we should include a sub-flag for schema validation level (strict|lenient). Also add per-call token caps returned so platforms can estimate cost.
Emma: Prioritization: MVP (2 weeks): flags + profiles + basic docs. Stretch (4-6 weeks): streaming metadata, per-call token caps, tool JSON contract.
Alice: Risks — exposing exact token caps could increase support churn. Maybe expose ranges (small|medium|large) + numeric max for enterprise tiers.
Ben: Cost tradeoff: higher advertised token limits require larger reserved KV caches on Dedicated. Need pricing note in spec.
Carla: Customer asks: @sales asked that discovery include "supported plugin list" (vendor names) and whether offline on-prem supports tool calling. Add as optional fields.
prod-bot: Deploy scheduled: spec-draft v0.1 by Emma at 1825020000, review meeting 1825050000.
Emma: I'll draft the v0.1 JSON schema and a sample SDK helper for reading profiles. Assigning follow-ups: @Dmitri will prototype the per-call cap reporting; @Carla will pull customer asks; @Ben will draft pricing implications.
Alice: Thanks — aim to keep the initial response compact. We'll iterate after customer validation. :thumbsup:
